data.title: A new Little Prince museum has opened its doors in Switzerland
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: 音乐剧《小王子》将于12月5日重返巴塞罗那开启第12季演出。该剧此前已演出600多场，吸引40万观众观看，创下西班牙音乐剧最长演出纪录。今年演出季将持续至2026年1月4日，在巴塞罗那Coliseum剧院上演。制作团队表示，这部改编自法国经典的剧目通过独特视角讲述成长故事，其成功源于对原著的忠实呈现和创新的舞台表现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：《小王子》这本书的价值、影响力和跨代际的吸引力

不同观点：
• 正面评价：多位评论者高度赞扬《小王子》的文学价值
- aweb认为它富有创造力、诗意且感人
- ares623特别欣赏书中关于"完美"的名言
- deeptishukla22指出其主题(失去、想象力、责任等)具有普世性
- bane提到童年观看PBS改编版的深刻记忆

• 文化影响讨论：
- kensai认为这本书能跨越文化界限
- dudeinjapan提到日本曾有的小王子博物馆(1999-2023)
- aryonoco表示每十年重读都有新收获

• 质疑声音：
- KPGv2表示40年从未读过，质疑其知名度
- karlgkk怀疑对30岁以下人群的相关性，认为这是"婴儿潮一代最后的喘息"
- charcircuit声称从未听说过这本书，质疑其流行度

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：
- 这本书的实际流行程度和跨代际吸引力
- 对年轻一代是否仍然有意义

• 其他讨论点：
- mactavish88提到书中美丽与悲剧并存的特质，并推荐了心理学分析书籍
- NiloCK用戏仿小王子对话风格评论现代人的无聊状态

data.title: AI just proved Erdos Problem #124
data.author: nl
data.article_summary: 这篇文章提示用户某些隐私相关扩展可能导致x.com网站出现问题，建议用户禁用这些扩展后重新尝试访问。内容简明扼要地指出问题原因和解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[AI在数学问题解决中的实际能力与局限性]

不同观点：
• [AI能力有限论]
  - kelseyfrog指出，尽管AI能解决Erdős问题，但在千禧年难题上仍得0分，认为AI需在这些更高难度问题上证明自己才算真正的AI。
  - magicalist和newmana强调，被解决的Erdős问题#124因表述缺陷而意外简单，且并非原始论文中的版本，暗示AI的成就被夸大。

• [AI进步肯定论]
  - harshitaneja认为，AI在解决奥林匹克级数学问题、处理自然语言和图像数据方面的进展令人惊叹，尽管不意味着AGI的到来，但仍值得赞赏。
  - ComplexSystems视此为AI自动定理证明的重要里程碑，认为这是技术的核心目标。

• [AI工具论]
  - BanditDefender主张AI是加速数学研究的工具，类似于传统符号计算，但批评将AI神化为“数学超级智能”的过度宣传。
  - WhyOhWhyQ预测AI未来将在复杂组合问题、材料设计和生物医学等领域发挥模式识别优势，弥补人类兴趣或理解力的局限。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：AI是否真正解决了原始Erdős问题（#124的表述差异），以及其成果的“开创性”是否被夸大（magicalist vs. ComplexSystems）。
- 验证问题：wasmainiac质疑结果的可靠性，而demirbey05通过数学家评论指出，尽管证明简单，但计算机验证（Lean）确保了其正确性。
- 历史背景：menaerus提到AI此前已解决Erdős问题#340，显示技术延续性；adt则声称GPT-5独立解决了问题#848（需验证）。

data.title: The Thinking Game Film – Google DeepMind documentary
data.author: ChrisArchitect
data.article_summary: 这篇文章主要内容是关于一个电子邮件订阅服务的简洁说明，强调了对用户隐私的尊重，并表达了感谢之意。整体语言简洁明了，旨在获取用户信任并鼓励订阅。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[纪录片对AI发展的呈现及对DeepMind和Demis Hassabis的评价]

不同观点：
• 对AI娱乐用途的批评：用户incognito124认为图像和视频生成的娱乐用途是浪费资源。
• 对Demis Hassabis的赞扬：用户someguy101010和redbell高度评价Hassabis的开放态度和领导力，认为他是科技行业的超级英雄。
• 对纪录片内容的质疑：用户nightski和jnwatson认为纪录片过于美化Hassabis和DeepMind，缺乏技术深度，更像是一部宣传片。
• 对纪录片真实性的讨论：用户mattlondon对Hassabis的“家庭场景”拍摄地点提出疑问，质疑其真实性。
• 对AI技术发展的反思：用户ilaksh提到纪录片省略了LLMs等技术的讨论，认为即使是最顶尖的AI天才也可能错过重大突破。

补充讨论：
• 用户quirino和sakesun对纪录片中展示的多模态AI技术的真实性和时效性提出质疑，认为部分内容可能已经过时或被夸大。
• 用户dwroberts希望看到由外部电影制作人拍摄的更具批判性的纪录片，而非Google的宣传片。
• 用户mskogly指出AI领域发展迅速，任何纪录片都可能很快过时，同时表达了对AI在视频剪辑中应用的期望。

争议焦点：
• 纪录片是否过于美化DeepMind和Hassabis，缺乏客观批判。
• 纪录片中展示的AI技术是否真实可靠，是否存在夸大或过时的问题。

data.title: Langjam Gamejam: Build a programming language then make a game with it
data.author: birdculture
data.article_summary: Langjam Gamejam是一场为期7天的编程马拉松（2025年12月14-20日），参与者需在7天内完成两个任务：1）设计并实现一门编程语言；2）用该语言开发一款游戏。活动鼓励创意，不限制技术栈，允许自定义"编程语言"和"游戏"的概念，个人或团队均可参加。优秀作品将获得奖励，撰写开发博客还能获得加分。最终作品需提交至Itch.io平台。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[设计专门用于游戏开发的最小化编程语言的可行性与挑战]

不同观点：
• 支持使用现有最小化语言（如Forth或Lisp）：认为可以快速实现（如[copx]提到"一天内写出基本解释器"），且已有语言足够灵活（如[kderbyma]使用LUA子集处理核心逻辑）。
• 主张设计全新专用语言：如[Razengan]提出需要"从零构建的游戏逻辑语言"，批评通用语言存在"50年前的陈旧约定"，理想语言应结合GDScript语法和Swift特性。
• 中间派实用方案：部分开发者（如[kderbyma]）采用领域特定语言(DSL)处理特定环节（如过场动画），而非全面替换现有技术栈。

争议焦点：
1. 必要性争议：是否值得为游戏开发专门设计语言（[Razengan]认为必要 vs [kderbyma]认为"完全用自定义语言不必要"）
2. 实现难度评估：[amarant]认为需要"疯狂多样的技能组合"，而[copx]认为使用Forth/Lisp变体"并不难"

补充讨论：
• 可行性案例：[shoo]提出非图灵完备语言的可能性，建议通过声明式语法描述游戏实体
• 实际障碍：[pixelmelt]和[FjordWarden]指出时间约束问题
• 工具链考量：[empressplay]推荐Logo+Go组合，[kderbyma]分享DSL与引擎结合的实际经验

46097671.article_content:
Langjam Gamejam
A 7-day hackathon where you build a programming language and then make a game using it.
Dates: December 14, 2025 – December 20, 2025
Langjam Gamejam is a 7-day challenge to create a programming language and then use that language to build a game. You set the rules. Be as creative as possible, use any technologies you want, and have fun. There will be prizes for the most creative submissions!
Rules
The hackathon runs for 7 days
You must design and implement a programming language
You must design and implement a game using your language
You can use any language, engine, libraries, and technologies
You define what a programming language is and what a game is
Work solo or on a team
Documentation and instructions are encouraged
Bonus points:
Write a blog post about your language, game, and design process
Join the jam and submit on
Itch.io
.
© 2025
Austin Z. Henley

data.title: I made a quieter air purifier
data.author: crescit_eundo
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[DIY空气净化器使用电脑风扇的可行性与效果]

不同观点：
• [支持使用电脑风扇的观点]
  - 电脑风扇（如Noctua NF-P14）安静、耐用且价格合理（scosman、ruralfam、Night_Thastus）
  - 多风扇组合可以覆盖更广的频率范围，减少噪音（DCKP）
  - 电脑风扇市场竞争激烈，产品经过优化（Night_Thastus）

• [质疑电脑风扇效果的观点]
  - 电脑风扇设计用于低压气流，可能不适合高过滤压力的场景（skhameneh）
  - 与传统风扇（如box fan）相比，电脑风扇的气流可能不足（dpark）
  - 需要更多关于静态压力的测试数据（skhameneh）

• [其他替代方案]
  - 推荐商业DIY套件（如CleanAirKits）（codemac、Night_Thastus）
  - 推荐Conway空气净化器作为DIY替代（tyre）

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：电脑风扇的气流和压力是否足以支持高效过滤（dpark vs scosman）
- 静电MERV-8过滤器对轮胎粉尘的效果（ruralfam）
- Corsi-Rosenthal方法的实用性争议（calvinmorrison认为其过于简单，学术炒作）
- 电脑风扇的静音设计（如Noctua）被广泛认可（erwincoumans）

data.title: Hacking on the ReMarkable 2
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了作者购买reMarkable 2电子纸平板的体验。作者称赞其书写体验优秀，触控笔摩擦感恰到好处，延迟低，擦除功能实用，但触摸手势操作体验不佳。阅读PDF文件表现尚可，但缺乏一些专业功能。作者特别提到用它阅读乐谱的不足，如无法精确裁剪页面、缺少半页翻页功能等。最后作者肯定了reMarkable公司对设备开放性的支持，允许用户自行开发软件，没有刻意锁定设备。整体评价是作为专注写作的设备表现优秀，但在专业领域功能上仍有欠缺。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[ReMarkable 2/Pro 设备的优缺点及潜在改进方向]

不同观点：
• [实用但硬件不足的观点]

46099997.article_content:
Since last Wednesday, I am the proud owner of a
reMarkable 2
. There was a black friday discount and some refurbished deals that meant I could get the tablet, the Marker Plus and the book cover for a little over the asking price of the base tablet and marker so I decided to take advantage of it.
A short review
The reMarkable is marketed as a distraction-free reading and writing device, and I can confirm that it excels at writing. The friction of the stylus on the epaper display feels just right, the latency is low enough that it resembles writing with ink that takes an instant to set on the page, and you can customize the brush enough to achieve whatever effect you want. I haven't written this much since I was in high school and I think I kind of missed it.
The Marker Plus includes an eraser on the other end of the stylus; if you're thinking of getting one of these things I'd recommend spending a bit more to get this version of the marker because I can imagine erasing things to get very annoying. The other options you have for erasing are a two-tap gesture to undo the last stroke (which I use a lot to delete the last letter if it didn't turn out right), and a selection eraser tool which is useful for deleting entire paragraphs.
The touch gestures are not great: they don't always register and they always need a bit more pressure than you might expect. Navigating with the stylus is much more pleasant, but some things (turning pages) you can only do by swiping. The reMarkable 1 used to have three physical buttons below the screen, and I wish the second iteration had kept those.
Reading PDFs is serviceable (papers are kind of annoying to read because you have to zoom in just a little to read comfortably) and I haven't tested ebooks yet.
Obviously the reMarkable has
its own subscription service
called Connect that unlocks some useful features like unlimited cloud storage (the free plan seems to delete files from the cloud after 50 days of inactivity), editing documents in the companion desktop and mobile apps, "premium templates", screen sharing, an extended warranty, and a few other things.
At $29.90 a year honestly it's not such a bad deal, and even the free plan's limitations are not too bad. The signup procedure for my.reMarkable deceptively funnels you into signing up for a 50 day trial and I couldn't find a comprehensive page that shows what you get without paying, but if you don't give up your payment info you'll find that you can still see your cloud synced files and enable the Google Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive integration.
Reading sheet music
One of the reasons why I wanted to get an epaper tablet was to read sheet music. I sing in a choir and we have a concert coming up during which we won't be allowed to use regular tablets due to the backlighting, and it felt like the perfect excuse to get one of these things to play with.
Reading sheet music is not great on the reMarkable. The refresh rate while turning pages is serviceable, and annotating PDFs with the stylus is a great experience, but there's a few features I have gotten used to on MobileSheets on my tablet that the reMarkable does not support:
Cropping pages individually. The document viewer lets you zoom in, but it's imprecise and it gets applied to the whole document, and I don't think the zoom level and offset is saved when switching to another document.
Half-page turning. When you turn a page in MobileSheets, you can set it to overlay half of the next page on the current one so you can follow the last bar while checking what's coming up next.
Turning pages with a single touch. I mentioned that I don't really like the swipe gestures and I'm not looking forward to fighting gesture recognition while trying to turn a page during a performance.
Library management. The reMarkable only displays a PDF's filename, but I like to keep my scores indexed by both name and composer/arranger and I'd much rather use metadata rather than a naming scheme to manage them.
Setlists. During a performance you don't want to be searching for the next piece and most pieces are going to be shared between many concerts. While you can organize documents by folder, duplicating a score in many different folders is not ideal.
These features are non-negotiable for a good music sheet reader and the reMarkable's stock software is not up to par. When I bought the reMarkable 2 I figured I could
just
write my own PDF reader and manager for it and work these features into it.
Running homebrew software
The reMarkable is a computer like any other, so I believe that since I bought it, I own it, and I should be able to run whatever software I want on it. On this front I have to give credit where it's due. reMarkable the company could've easily locked the device down to get you to pay for its subscription and buy new iterations of the device when they end support for the old ones, but if you go into the
Settings > Help > Copyright and licenses
menu you'll find a paragraph explaining that to

data.title: Replacing My Window Manager with Google Chrome
data.author: foxmoss
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个创新项目：用谷歌浏览器替换Linux桌面环境。作者开发了一个名为DoteWM的开源窗口管理器，通过Chromium嵌入式框架(CEF)将网页浏览器作为窗口管理器的前端界面，实现了用HTML/CSS/JavaScript来定制窗口装饰、背景和交互功能。该项目利用CEF的cefQuery接口实现了浏览器与底层系统的通信，让网页可以控制X11窗口的移动、调整大小等操作。这种方法降低了定制窗口管理器的技术门槛，使开发者可以通过修改网页代码而非传统编程来创建个性化的桌面环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[基于浏览器框架构建桌面环境的可行性与优缺点]

不同观点：
• 支持浏览器框架构建桌面环境
  - [yokljo]认为这是一个灵活的想法，展示了基于灵活框架的桌面环境可能性，并建议尝试CEF或Godot等框架。
  - [jauntywundrkind]提到Pyro Desktop曾经尝试类似概念（基于Firefox），认为这种方向有历史参考价值。
  - [GaryBluto]指出Chrome OS早期版本已经将这一理念推向极致，说明技术上是可行的。

• 反对或质疑浏览器框架的实用性
  - [jeffjeffbear]认为用浏览器替代操作系统“很奇怪且不理想”，更倾向于使用Firefox而非Chrome。
  - [rkagerer]直接质疑动机（“But why?”），暗示缺乏明确需求。
  - [wiseowise]调侃称这种想法会引发技术社区对“原生”的执念争议。

• 技术细节讨论
  - [SpikedCola]报告了Chrome 109中的字体渲染问题，涉及实际技术障碍。
  - [throwaway290]对Windows皮肤源码的困惑，反映实现复杂性。
  - [hulitu]通过对比X11和Windows的“年龄”讽刺技术新旧并非核心问题。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：浏览器框架是否适合作为桌面环境基础（性能、灵活性、用户体验等）。
- 历史类比：多次提及Chrome OS、Pyro Desktop和Windows 98 Active Desktop，显示该理念的延续性。
- 替代方案建议：如[yokljo]提出Godot引擎作为可能更优的UI框架选项。

46072521.article_content:
Nov 26, 2025
Replacing My Linux Desktop With Google Chrome
All code in this blog post is fully open source at
github.com/FoxMoss/DoteWM/
.
This is an image of my window manager with full X11 support but border decorations,
background, and window interactions are handled by a web browser.
Let me explain.
A Primer
To display a program window an operating system uses a window display server. On Linux this is
mainly X11 written by MIT in 1984, it’s old and starting to show it’s age and Wayland is taking some
of X11 market share. So with a window display server you can display windows, makes sense, but to
get the nice behavior of movement, resizing buttons, and keybinds, we need a window manager. This
is a separate program that the display server consults on how it should render and handle the
windows. Then all the windows need to know is how to talk to the display server and all the window
manager needs to know is how to handle the windows. This is a lovely system which allows for window
managers to take on all different kinds of shapes sizes and appearances while maintaining
general compatibility with most programs.
The goal of the project was to decrease the skill needed to write a fully customized window manager.
I’ve been aware of many projects that try to do the very opposite of this project for a while, i.e.
put the desktop environment into the web, with some decent success. See
puter
and
AnuraOS
for two great examples of such projects.
It’s quite a bit easier to tweak CSS constants, and JS snippets then it is to change style embedded
already in a long standing modern desktop/window manager. So lets bring the web to the desktop and
have a browser control the system. That’s the pitch and that’s what we’re going to do.
The Browser
So how do we actually pull off this magic trick? I started with the web browser because I figured
this would be the hardest bit. We need to communicate with the Javascript process while
keeping access to low level interfaces as to interact with our windows. Then the other requirement
is being able to serve our webpage without a HTTPS request leaving our computer.
How? CEF.
CEF also known as Chromium Embedded Framework is a multiplatform framework for writing web apps for
desktop with a nice C++ interface to boot. Like Electron but slightly lower level, it exposes the
functionality we need while abstracting the actual browser process away. As well as providing in an
easy to download binary instead of compiling the browser from scratch. So to load our files off the
user’s machine we can right a custom scheme. Like where the traditional chromium browser has
chrome://
we can do the same using a interface CEF provides.

And the actual code for finding and returning the file is fairly simple. Just read the file out of
the
~/.config/dote/
directory and if there is none return a 404. We also have a quick, and dirty
MIME type generator working purely on the file extensions. So every
.html
turns into a
text/html
and can be easily interpreted by the browser. I won’t bore you with the code, check out the repo if
you want an exact idea of the implementation.
Great.
Here I just give the
body
tag a
background-image
to act as a wallpaper.
The Layer Cake
So now that we can load HTML and Javascript files we now have a nice neat secure sandbox,
unfortunately we need to let it control our machine. I considered writing a websocket implementation
to work over the scheme. Then I found the cefQuery interface, which makes this a whole lot easier.

46072521.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个创新项目：用谷歌浏览器替换Linux桌面环境。作者开发了一个名为DoteWM的开源窗口管理器，通过Chromium嵌入式框架(CEF)将网页浏览器作为窗口管理器的前端界面，实现了用HTML/CSS/JavaScript来定制窗口装饰、背景和交互功能。该项目利用CEF的cefQuery接口实现了浏览器与底层系统的通信，让网页可以控制X11窗口的移动、调整大小等操作。这种方法降低了定制窗口管理器的技术门槛，使开发者可以通过修改网页代码而非传统编程来创建个性化的桌面环境。

data.title: SmartTube Compromised
data.author: akersten
data.article_summary: 本文报道了流行的YouTube替代应用SmartTube遭遇恶意软件攻击的事件。开发者确认用于构建官方APK文件的电脑被植入恶意程序，导致部分版本（如30.43和30.47）被感染。建议用户立即升级到最新30.56版本（通过特定下载代码获取），并最好对安装过旧版本的设备进行恢复出厂设置，同时检查Google和YouTube账户是否存在异常活动。开发者已清除受感染机器并更换数字签名，但恶意软件的具体危害尚不明确。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SmartTube开发者数字签名泄露及潜在安全风险

不同观点：
• **开发者应对措施的有效性质疑**
  - 有评论认为开发者仅更换签名而未说明泄露原因（如`breakingcups`指出），新签名可能以同样方式再次泄露
  - 开发者公告缺乏技术细节（`avereveard`批评未说明具体渠道、载荷特征等）

• **安卓生态安全模型讨论**
  - 部分用户肯定安卓沙箱机制限制了恶意软件危害（`Klaus23`举例说明仅需改密码）
  - 反对观点认为用户轻信第三方APK的行为本身存在风险（`GaryBluto`惊讶用户使用主账号登录）

• **供应链信任与分发方式争议**
  - 支持去中心化分发但需改进信任机制（`leo_e`提议多维护者签名/可重现构建）
  - 建议转向F-Droid等更透明平台（`lostmsu`回应Play商店政策限制）

补充讨论：
- **地缘政治猜测**：`bl4kers`提出可能是俄罗斯针对乌克兰开发者的攻击
- **行业影响担忧**：多人（如`boje`）担心事件被用作反对侧载的借口
- **用户行为反思**：`embedding-shape`质疑开发者未隔离签名密钥的生产环境管理
- **恶意软件能力疑问**：`reassess_blind`直接询问APK内恶意软件的具体危害

争议焦点：
1. 开发者处理方式是否足够透明/有效
2. 去中心化分发与用户验证责任的平衡
3. 事件是否会被滥用为限制侧载的论据

SmartTube’s official APK was compromised with malware — What you should do if you use it
Posted by
Elias Saba
on
November 29, 2025
—
16 Comments
Earlier this week, the developer of
SmartTube
, the most popular alternative YouTube app for Android TV and Fire TV devices, announced that his app’s
digital signature had been exposed
. A new version of the app using a new digital signature
has since been released
. While everyone is encouraged to switch to the new app, SmartTube’s developer has shared more information with me about what happened that may make you want to take additional precautions if you’ve installed or updated the app recently.
SmartTube’s developer told me that the computer used to create the APKs for the project’s official GitHub page was compromised by malware. As a result, some official SmartTube releases were unintentionally released with malware. It’s unclear which version was first affected, but the compromise seems to have first occurred earlier this month. SmartTube versions
30.43
and
30.47
from APKMirror are both being flagged as infected by malware scanners.
It is likely the presence of this malware that caused Google and Amazon to forcibly uninstall SmartTube on some devices, not the exposed digital signature as first suspected. SmartTube’s developer says the compromised machine has been wiped and is confident that both the new SmartTube releases and the machine that created them are malware-free.
All older versions of SmartTube have been removed from the project’s GitHub in an abundance of caution. While there does not appear to be any evidence that the app’s digital signature was actually stolen or used by malicious actors, that too has been abandoned and replaced with a new one.
SmartTube version 30.56 is the first release built by the uncompromised machine and with the new digital signature. It can be installed using my
Downloader
app by entering code
28544
for the stable release or code
79015
for the beta release. This release does not appear on
SmartTube’s release list
yet because it contains some known issues that the developer hopes to fix before publishing it there.
It remains unknown what the malware that found its way into the official SmartTube APK files can actually do. Thankfully, SmartTube is programmed to only request minimal account permissions and does not ask for any login information directly. Even if you granted the app access to your Google Drive for backup purposes, your Google account and general Google Drive files remain out of the app’s scope of permissions. Permissions regarding control of your YouTube account seem like the only thing that could have easily been exposed to the malware, as far as account access is concerned.
That said, since very little is know about the malware, you should assume the worst. If you use SmartTube and are concerned about your exposure to this malware, you should factory reset any device that had the app installed, especially if you installed or updated the app in November. It would also be a good idea to audit your
Google account permissions
and your
YouTube account activity
for anything unusual. Once your devices and account are in order, if you wish to reinstall SmartTube, be sure to only install the latest version through the codes/links above.

data.title: DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
data.author: victorbuilds
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了DeepSeekMath-V2，一个致力于实现自我验证数学推理的大语言模型。传统方法依赖最终答案的正确性作为奖励，但无法保证推理过程的严谨性。为解决这一问题，该模型通过训练验证器来检查数学证明的每一步，并利用验证结果优化证明生成器。模型在多个数学竞赛中表现出色，如IMO 2025和Putnam 2024。DeepSeekMath-V2基于DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base构建，采用Apache 2.0许可证发布。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[MetaMath模型的开源、性能及与OpenAI/DeepMind的比较]

不同观点：
• **开源优势观点**  
  - 强调MetaMath开源权重（Apache 2.0许可）的积极意义，对比OpenAI/DeepMind的闭源策略（如"gold models仍为专有"）。  
  - 例子：用户[victorbuilds]指出开源更透明，[terespuwash]质疑OpenAI未公开其金牌模型。

• **性能与测试质疑**  
  - [WhitneyLand]提出对模型真实能力的怀疑，认为其训练数据可能包含互联网泄露的竞赛题目，缺乏去污染验证。  
  - [ilmj8426]关注模型在数学/逻辑任务（如编程调试）中的潜力，但未直接回应质疑。  
  - [simianwords]补充指出该模型非通用型，与OpenAI/Google的通用模型定位不同。

• **技术实现争议**  
  - [H8crilA]质疑家庭设备（如CPU+1TB内存）能否运行此类模型，暗示实用性门槛。  
  - [LZ_Khan]提出模型是否直接蒸馏自OpenAI/Google输出的疑问，涉及数据来源争议。

补充讨论：

46105079.article_content:
DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
1. Introduction
Large language models have made significant progress in mathematical reasoning, which serves as an important testbed for AI and could impact scientific research if further advanced.
By scaling reasoning with reinforcement learning that rewards correct final answers, LLMs have improved from poor performance to saturating quantitative reasoning competitions like AIME and HMMT in one year.
However, this approach faces fundamental limitations.
Pursuing higher final answer accuracy doesn't address a key issue: correct answers don't guarantee correct reasoning.
Moreover, many mathematical tasks like theorem proving require rigorous step-by-step derivation rather than numerical answers, making final answer rewards inapplicable.
To push the limits of deep reasoning, we believe it is necessary to verify the comprehensiveness and rigor of mathematical reasoning.
Self-verification is particularly important for scaling test-time compute, especially for open problems without known solutions.
Towards self-verifiable mathematical reasoning, we investigate how to train an accurate and faithful LLM-based verifier for theorem proving.
We then train a proof generator using the verifier as the reward model, and incentivize the generator to identify and resolve as many issues as possible in their own proofs before finalizing them.
To maintain the generation-verification gap as the generator becomes stronger, we propose to scale verification compute to automatically label new hard-to-verify proofs, creating training data to further improve the verifier.
Our resulting model, DeepSeekMath-V2, demonstrates strong theorem-proving capabilities, achieving gold-level scores on IMO 2025 and CMO 2024 and a near-perfect 118/120 on Putnam 2024 with scaled test-time compute.
While much work remains, these results suggest that self-verifiable mathematical reasoning is a feasible research direction that may help develop more capable mathematical AI systems.

  - herghost: 最初认为模拟显示了三体问题的稳定解，但随后系统崩溃，符合预期。  
  - jahnu: 通过微调质量参数（如1.0001），可以观察到系统缓慢崩溃的过程。  

• [对经典模拟工具的怀旧]  
  - savrajsingh: 提到Mac应用“gravitation”类似功能。  
  - NKosmatos: 回忆Windows程序“Solarwinds”等，允许用户模拟行星轨道和轨迹。  

• [模拟的物理限制]  
  - npodbielski: 指出模拟中物体无法真正碰撞，即使接近也仅会改变方向。  

• [技术细节与改进建议]  
  - d4rkn0d3z: 建议使用广义相对论的测地线方程（如史瓦西度规）替代牛顿力学（F=ma），以更精确地描述天体运动，尤其是在黑洞附近。  

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：是否需要在模拟中引入更复杂的物理模型（如广义相对论）以提升准确性，还是当前的简化模型已足够。  
• 其他讨论点：用户界面优化（如质量调整的显示问题）、高刷新率显示效果（modeless提到240 Hz显示器的观感）。

data.article_summary: 科学家首次在火星上检测到闪电。通过分析毅力号火星车两年多来收集的28小时录音，研究人员发现了55次与闪电相关的放电现象。这些闪电主要发生在强风、尘暴和尘卷风期间，表明火星上的静电现象可能与尘埃摩擦有关。这项发表在《自然》杂志上的研究不仅证实了长期以来的理论，还对未来火星探测任务（包括载人任务）的安全具有重要意义，因为静电放电可能对设备和宇航员构成威胁。

Space & Spaceflight
We’ve Detected Lightning on Mars for the First Time
Scientists analyzed 28 hours of recordings over two Martian years, listening for electrical signals.
By
Passant Rabie
Published November 26, 2025
Reading time 2 minutes
A dust devil on Mars, as captured by the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter on March 14, 2012.
Image: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Univ. of Arizona Animation Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech
Read Later
Read Later
Comments
(10)
Dust devils on Mars could be brewing electric currents, and scientists may have just heard them strike the arid landscape in a first-of-its-kind discovery.
Planetary scientists detected new evidence of lightning on Mars in sounds and electrical signals captured by the Perseverance rover, suggesting the Red Planet’s dusty surface causes electrification. Astronomers have long theorized that lightning exists on Mars but have thus far failed to find direct evidence of it. The new
study
, published Wednesday in the journal
Nature,Â
further deepens our understanding of Mars’ atmosphere and may have implications for future human-led missions to the neighboring planet.
Lightning doesn’t strike twice
NASA’s Perseverance rover
landed on Mars in February 2021
, and it’s
equipped with a microphone to capture the sounds of the planet
. The team of researchers behind the new study analyzed 28 hours of recordings captured by the rover’s SuperCam microphone.
By listening to the sounds of Mars, the team identified interference and acoustic signatures in the recordings that are characteristic of lightning. A total of 55 events were detected over a period of two Martian years (nearly four years on Earth). The majority of the time when lightning was detected, it correlated with strong winds on Mars, dust devils, and dust storms. The study suggests that wind plays an important role in sparking lightning.
Unlike Earth, Marsâ atmosphere is too thin to support tornadoes. Instead, as air near the planetâs surface heats up and rises to meet the cooler, denser air, it begins to rotate. As more air joins the column, it picks up speed, as well as dust, and
creates a swirling dust devil
. NASAâs Viking mission was the first to spot the devils on Mars in the 1970s, and the dusty phenomenon was later captured by the Curiosity and Perseverance rovers.
On Earth, lightning commonly strikes along with thunderstorms. Dust devils on Earth, however, also produce similar friction that sometimes generates electric charges, with dust particles rubbing against each other instead of water and ice inside thunderclouds. That friction builds up charges, and the increasing buildup can be released in the form of lightning.
For that reason, scientists have theorized that lightning, or electrical discharges within the atmosphere, takes place on Mars. A 2009
study
found signs of electrical discharges during dust storms on the Red Planet, suggesting evidence for dry lightning. Follow-up research, however, failed to detect radio evidence of the so-called dry lightning.
The new study presents an unprecedented direct detection of lightning on Mars, based on the acoustics produced by electric discharges. The scientists behind the study, an international team of researchers led by Baptiste Chide from the Research Institute in Astrophysics and Planetology in France, note that the electrostatic discharges could pose a threat to the roaming rovers, as well as future astronaut missions to the Red Planet.
“A better understanding of these discharges will help to protect future explorers (robots or astronauts) from their effects,” the researchers wrote.

data.article_summary: trifold是一个通过CDN部署静态网站的工具，支持HTML/CSS/JS等静态资源。它提供简单CLI，可初始化项目、同步文件、配置域名、设置成本上限等。相比免费托管服务，trifold基于付费CDN（目前仅支持bunny.net），以更低成本（存储$0.01/GB/月）提供稳定服务，适合个人开发者。安装可通过uv工具或Python包管理器完成。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：静态网站托管和CDN的选择与使用

不同观点：
• 传统托管 vs CDN：jrm4询问CDN是否是必需还是习惯使然，Brajeshwar表示Cloudflare的免费套餐足够个人使用，且成本为零。
• 低成本CDN选项：Brajeshwar提到Bunny CDN的最低费用较高（约50美元），不适合个人项目。faizshah补充Backblaze B2与Bunny的集成可作为廉价替代方案。
• 静态网站的进阶需求：CrimsonCape询问静态CDN之后的下一步，可能涉及虚拟容器或动态后端（如Node.js），并提到自托管WordPress或集成支付处理器的需求。
• 简易静态托管方案：bradley_taunt认为静态网站托管无需复杂化，推荐NearlyFreeSpeech等廉价主机（每天约0.03美元），e12e补充Neocities提供免费CDN托管。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：是否必须使用CDN（如Cloudflare）或传统托管更简单高效。
• 技术扩展：chanux分享私有静态站点的身份验证方案（GCP免费层），0x3f指出Trifold与Cloudflare Pages/Netlify的功能差异（动态计算 vs 静态托管）。

46031608.article_content:
trifold
¶
trifold
is a tool to serve static websites using a content delivery network (CDN).
Source:
https://codeberg.org/jpt/trifold/
This allows painless deployment of sites consisting entirely of static assets (HTML, CSS, JS, images) for pennies a month.
It is the perfect companion to deploy sites built with static-site generators like
Hugo
,
Zola
,
Quarto
, or
zensical
.
The tool provides a simple CLI that allows:
initializing new projects without touching the CDN web interface
syncing local HTML/CSS/JS/etc. to the CDN & clearing the cache
configuring a custom domain name to point at your files, with SSL enabled
setting a maximum monthly cost to avoid surprise bills
using CDN edge functions to support redirects
This project grew out of frustration with services making their free tier less friendly to indie devs and students that just need a cheap & reliable place they can host things.
trifold
offers an easy alternative to services like Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, and GitHub pages.
Instead of relying on a free service it is hopefully going to be more stable to rely on a paid service with a reasonable price point and the ability to set billing limits.
Installation
¶
If you have
uv
installed, you can run
uvx trifold
without a separate installation step.
This is the recommended method,
uvx
is a built-in alias for
uv tool run
. (See
https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/tools/#running-tools
if you're curious to learn more.)
To upgrade:
uv tool upgrade trifold
You can also use any Python package manager you prefer,
pip
,
pipx
,
poetry
, etc. to install in your preferred manner.
bunny.net & pricing
¶
At the moment
bunny.net
1
is the only supported provider, but others can be added.
bunny.net is a professional-grade CDN that is also very affordable.
Like most hosts, they charge for both storage & bandwidth.
Both starts at $0.01/GB/mo.
The typical static webpage is under 1GB, meaning storage costs will be negligible unless you decide to host audio/video. And if you do, the rates are
far
cheaper than most competitors, see their
pricing
for details.
In terms of bandwidth, let's say your page size is 2MB (a moderate-sized page) and hits the front page of a popular website, driving a surge of 25,000 hits. (
Congrats!
)
Not only will your site handle the traffic just fine, your total bill will be
$0.50 for the 50GB of bandwidth used.
(You could serve a million hits, ~2TB, for $20.)
Of course, most sites will only get a fraction of this traffic.
It is possible to host dozens of low-traffic sites for the $1/monthly minimum bill.
This is a referral link, using it supports development of the project.

data.title: Self-hosting a Matrix server for 5 years
data.author: the-anarchist
data.article_summary: 本文作者分享了自己五年来自托管Matrix服务器的经验。主要内容包括：1) Matrix协议的数据复制机制存在隐私问题；2) 使用Synapse服务器的优缺点，如需要PostgreSQL、缺乏管理界面、需要定期清理、数据库膨胀问题等；3) 用户账号无法真正删除的隐私隐患；4) 未来的发展方向是Element公司提供的ESS一体化解决方案。作者运行这个小服务器（不到10个用户）时遇到了诸多技术挑战，特别是数据管理和隐私方面的问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Matrix 自托管的使用体验、技术挑战及未来发展前景  

不同观点：  
• **正面体验**  
  - 用户[lousken]表示自2017年以来RAM使用量减少60%，运行稳定，迁移到NVMe SSD后性能显著提升  
  - [pelzatessa]认为Synapse维护体验良好，尽管偶尔崩溃，但整体满足现代自托管通信需求  
  - [maelito]称消息解密问题已解决，计划弃用WhatsApp/Telegram  

• **负面体验与核心问题**  
  - [styanax]批评加密同步故障、通知延迟、消息清理困难（删除2年聊天记录需数十小时）  
  - [The_President]指出缺乏简单管理面板是致命缺陷，最终转向XMPP  
  - [Barathkanna]总结自托管因复杂性失控而衰落，便利性逐渐压倒自主权  

• **技术争议焦点**  
  - SQLite可靠性：[Aurornis][chrismorgan]质疑Synapse的SQLite必然损坏说法，要求具体证据  
  - 数据复制机制：[jamesbelchamber]认为房间数据跨服务器复制是双刃剑，导致社区与基础设施错位  
  - 客户端分裂：[lousken]批评Element-X与旧版客户端不兼容，视频通话功能断裂  

补充讨论：  
- 存储管理痛点：多位用户提到附件无法清理（[lousken]积压50GB）、数据库膨胀（[pelzatessa]10用户1.5年占用10GB）  
- 轻量化替代方案：[pferde]证实非联邦模式可稳定运行家庭服务器  
- 生态进展：新工具链（如rust-synapse-compress-state）开始优化资源占用，但客户端体验仍落后于Signal/DeltaChat

46106132.article_content:
Self-hosting a Matrix server for 5 years
Experiences with the Matrix protocol, Matrix Synapse server, bridges, and Element mobile apps.
I have been hosting a Matrix server for about five years now, mostly for text chats between a few relatives and close friends, and a bridge to WhatsApp for a few more people. These are my experiences.
Matrix protocol
I don't have many thoughts on the protocol itself.
The only thing that I don't really understand is the decision on data replication. If a user on server A joins a room on server B, recent room data is copied from server B to server A and then kept in sync on both servers. I suppose this reduces the load on the original server at the expense of federation overhead and space on other servers. However, this also creates a situation where anything said across federation cannot be unsaid, which is an ironic situation for a protocol/system that often comes up when talking about privacy.
IIRC, fediverse/ActivityPub uses a similar approach.
Synapse server
Synapse is the only choice that supports bridges, which was why I wanted to try Matrix in the first place. And back in 2019-2020 this was the only choice anyway.
As of right now, I run Synapse, PostgreSQL, and coturn directly, without containerization, on a small VPS.
Works well
Works fairly reliably, supports bridges, and is more efficient that it was in 2020.
API is well documented, and allows authenticating and sending (unencrypted) messages via simple HTTP calls. At some point in time, I wanted to write a simple shell client to use with SXMO and such.
Does not have an admin panel
There is no admin page or panel. There was a third-party admin site, but it's an entire site just for making HTTP calls. So I ended up writing my own.
My Simple Synapse Admin page
(Nowadays, the ESS deployment includes developer-made admin, see Future section)
Requires PostgreSQL
While technically, Synapse can work with a sqlite database (and which at first seems like an OK choice for having <10 users on the server), it WILL become corrupted. So PostgreSQL is de-facto mandatory.
(Already a part of new ESS)
Requires federation
Initial setup presumes that the server is going to be federated, and there is no good way to turn it off. The best workaround involves a blank whitelist of federated servers.
GitHub issue: Single config option to disable federation
I don't know the implications of disabling it.
Needs constant cleanup
Message retention policy can be set up server-wide, but also per-room. There are specific lines in the configuration that need to be set to actually enable a service that runs the cleanup.
Synapse keeps the room even after all of the members leave it, including federated rooms. This results in many (sometimes large) rooms without local members orphaned on the server, taking up database space.
Deleting messages (events) with attachments does not delete the attachment (because another message might refer to it?), which means that the sent files continue existing on the server indefinitely. Another privacy implication. A simple "delete all files older than X" script works great until it deletes avatars. So yeah, seems like this is something that should be handled by the Synapse server instead of cobbled-together scripts.
Even after extensive cleanup, PostgreSQL database might need to be vacuumed to reduce the disk space it takes up.
Database grows out of control
Even for my small server with <10 active users, database size reached several gigabytes.
Synapse keeps track of room states in an append-only (!) table named state_groups_state. Deleting a room does not delete the state_groups_state records. So it is never automatically cleaned up, and grows in size infinitely. It is possible to delete many of those records from the database directly, and Element (the company) provides some tool to "compress" those records, but again, something that should be handled by the server.
Good article about state_groups_state
Users cannot be deleted
This is simply not an option in the API. Server admin can perform a "deactivate" (disable login) and "erase" (remove related data, which claims to be GDPR-compliant) on user accounts, but the accounts themselves stay on the server forever.
Wait, what? Why?
How this not considered a GDPR violation is a mystery to me. Even on my tiny server, I have users who use their first name as their ID and bridged WhatsApp users that use phone numbers as IDs.
GitHub issue
Future
While Matrix-Element ecosystem has been catering towards government and corporate entities for some time, there have been multiple recent announcements about its future.
Specifically, Element (the company) is now providing an all-in-one Element Server Suite (ESS) to replace the current setup, including
ESS Community
It is intended for non-professional use, evaluations, and small to mid-sized deployments (1â100 users).
ESS Community includes 7 components/services, now requires a minimum of 2 CPUs, 2GB of RAM, and runs using... Kube

data.title: Games using anti-cheats and their compatibility with GNU/Linux or Wine/Proton
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 这篇文章汇总了多款游戏的防作弊系统与Linux/Wine/Proton的兼容情况。主要分类包括：17%游戏官方支持（如《光环：士官长合集》）、23%可运行（如《神之浩劫》）、56%无法运行（如《绝地求生》）、4%明确拒绝支持（如《堡垒之夜》）。每款游戏条目都标注了防作弊类型、兼容状态、运行条件和最后更新时间。该列表通过众包方式持续维护，为Linux玩家提供实时参考，部分游戏需特定补丁或Proton GE才能运行。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[游戏反作弊系统的必要性、实施方式及其对用户体验和隐私的影响]

不同观点：
• 反作弊系统是必要的，但当前的方式过于侵入性（如rootkit级别的权限），且未能完全解决问题。部分原因是游戏公司取消了玩家自建服务器的传统模式，导致完全依赖官方反作弊系统（LanceH）。
• 反作弊系统可以通过服务器端检测（如行为分析和统计模型）实现，不一定需要客户端的高权限（kamranjon, cornichon622）。
• 反作弊系统对游戏体验至关重要，即使需要高权限（如内核级反作弊），只要能有效阻止作弊者，也是值得的（lwansbrough）。
• 反作弊系统在Linux平台上难以实现，因为其开放性和可定制性使得绕过反作弊变得容易（hastily3114）。
• 游戏公司忽视Linux用户可能会损失收入，随着Steam OS和Steam Deck的普及，这一用户群体正在增长（jillesvangurp）。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：反作弊系统的侵入性与隐私问题（bflesch, 999900000999） vs. 反作弊系统对游戏公平性的必要性（lwansbrough）。
• 其他讨论点：开源游戏（如Beyond All Reason）通过社区监督和公开记录减少作弊（Buttons840）；部分玩家因反作弊系统的不兼容性放弃游戏（drnick1, droolboy）；游戏平台（如Switch）的安全性问题（__alexs）。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Raspberry Pi 及内存价格上涨的原因、影响及未来预测]

不同观点：

data.title: KDE Plasma 6.8 Set to Drop X11 Support Completely
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: KDE Plasma 6.8将完全放弃对X11的支持，仅支持Wayland显示协议，计划于2027年完成过渡。目前大多数用户已在使用Wayland，X11应用将通过Xwayland兼容层运行。开发者表示此举能加快桌面环境的功能改进，且Wayland在游戏性能和NVIDIA显卡支持方面已有显著提升。虽然仍存在部分未解决的问题，但团队已为这一重大转变做好准备。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[KDE决定在Plasma 6.8中放弃对X11的支持，转而全面支持Wayland]

不同观点：
• **支持KDE的决定**  
  - [gpm]认为缩小工作范围对项目有益，KDE应专注于Wayland或X11之一，而不是同时支持两者。  
  - [unethical_ban]表示使用Wayland时从未遇到重大问题，支持KDE的决策。

• **反对KDE的决定**  
  - [mikkupikku]表示如果KDE放弃X11支持，他将不再使用KDE，并坚持不转向Wayland。  
  - [globnomulous]提到此举可能影响无障碍功能（accessibility）。  

• **认为时机不成熟**  
  - [vkaku]建议推迟到KDE 7.0/8.0再放弃X11，因为许多应用和驱动尚未准备好支持Wayland/XWayland。  
  - [vrighter]批评现代趋势是“在功能未完成前就发布”，认为Wayland尚未达到与X11的功能对等。  

• **对兼容性的担忧**  
  - [potato-peeler]询问X11-only应用是否会停止开箱即用（OOTB）。  

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于Wayland的成熟度、功能完整性以及对现有用户和应用的兼容性影响。  
- 部分用户（如[CapricornNoble]）因配置麻烦而选择继续使用X11，但未明确反对KDE的决定。

46105798.article_content:
KDE Plasma 6.8 Set to Drop X11 Support Completely
Long transition nears completion as developers address remaining concerns. Plasma 6.8 is still two years away.
Sourav Rudra
27 Nov 2025
2 min read
On this page
A growing number of Linux
desktop environments
(DEs) are moving towards
Wayland
, the modern display protocol designed to replace the aging
X11
window system.
X11 has been the foundation of Linux graphical interfaces for over three decades now, but it carries significant technical debt and security limitations that Wayland aims to address.
Projects like Fedora, GNOME, and KDE have been leading the charge on this by being among the first ones to adopt Wayland.
Now, KDE has announced
it is sunsetting the Plasma X11 session entirely
.
What's Happening:
The
KDE Plasma
team has made it clear that
the upcoming Plasma 6.8 release will be Wayland-exclusive
and that the Plasma X11 session will not be included in it.
Support for X11 applications will be handled entirely through
Xwayland
, a compatibility layer that allows X11 apps to run on Wayland compositors. The Plasma X11 session itself will continue to receive support until early 2027.
Though, the developers have not provided a specific end date yet, as they are working on additional bug-fix releases for Plasma 6.7.
The rationale behind this change is to allow the Plasma team to move faster on improving the stability and functionality of the DE. They stated that dropping X11 support will help them adapt without dragging forward legacy support that holds back development.
What to Expect:
For most users, this change is said to have minimal immediate impact. KDE says that the vast majority of their users are already using the Wayland session, and it has been the default on most distributions.
Users who still require X11 can opt for long-term support distributions like
AlmaLinux 9
, for example, which includes the Plasma X11 session and will be supported until 2032.
The developers also note that
gaming performance has improved on Wayland
. The session supports adaptive sync, optional tearing, and high-refresh-rate multi-monitor setups out of the box. HDR gaming works with some additional configuration.
Plus,
users of NVIDIA GPUs can breathe easy now
, as Wayland support in the proprietary NVIDIA driver has matured significantly. Graphics cards supported by the manufacturer work well nowadays. For older NVIDIA hardware, the open source
Nouveau
driver can be used instead.
There are some issues that the Plasma team is actively working on addressing, things like output mirroring, session restore, and remembering window positions. But overall,
they seem well-prepared
for this massive shift.
Suggested Read 📖
U Turn! X11 is Back in GNOME 49, For Now
A temporary move that gives people some breathing room.
It's FOSS

data.author: robtaylor
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[OBR提前发布经济与财政展望文件的安全漏洞及其影响]

不同观点：
• **技术配置错误观点**  
  - fabian2k指出服务器未正确配置，允许绕过认证直接访问文件，WordPress的默认行为存在隐患。  
  - pentagrama质疑WordPress默认是否允许未发布的媒体文件通过URL直接访问，认为插件可能非唯一漏洞来源。  
  - hombre_fatal认为问题非WordPress本身缺陷，而是通用文件服务实践（如无随机URL）的疏忽。

• **人为过失与制度失职观点**  
  - varispeed批评这是“制度性 incompetence”，指责机构未进行基本测试（如URL猜测）和缺乏访问控制。  
  - chuckreynolds归因为“人为错误”，TheRealPomax补充“无人被付费审查插件”暗示管理漏洞。  
  - rvz抨击政府机构使用WordPress存储敏感信息，类比为“将核密码写在便签上”，认为安全基础薄弱。

• **事件严重性与影响争议**  
  - londons_explore质疑提前发布是否真是“15年最严重失误”，指出信息可能已通过非正式渠道泄露。  
  - M2Ys4U怀疑报告中43次访问数据低估实际传播（如社交媒体扩散）。  
  - almostkindatech和jamesbelchamber强调政治后果（OBR主席辞职）及媒体关注度。

补充讨论：
- **争议焦点**：是否WordPress应为事件主责（技术缺陷 vs 人为配置失误）。  
- **关键论据**：文件URL被提前猜测（44次请求）、服务器未隔离未发布内容、插件功能误解。  
- **延伸讨论**：政府机构使用低成本CMS的合理性（merrvk）、内部交易可能性（rvz提及“内幕交易”）。

data.title: Cartographers have been hiding illustrations inside Switzerland’s maps (2020)
data.author: mhb
data.article_summary: 瑞士地形测绘局（Swisstopo）的地图制作师们在其官方地图中隐藏了一些趣味图案，如蜘蛛、人脸、裸女、土拨鼠等。这些并非失误，而是制图师故意违反"还原现实"准则的秘密创作。多数图案在创作者退休后才被发现，其中半数已被移除。最新发现的土拨鼠图案也将于明年被删除。这些隐藏图案既是制图师缓解精密工作压力的方式，也是对体制的温和反抗。有些图案（如1958年创作的裸女）隐藏了近60年才被发现。虽然官方认为"创意在地图上没有容身之处"，但这些秘密作品展现了制图工作中的人性化一面。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：瑞士官方地图中隐藏的插图和彩蛋现象及其文化意义

不同观点：
• [历史浪漫主义视角]
  - 用户keepamovin以16世纪制图师自比，赞美过去制图师冒险在作品中隐藏异端元素的精神，讽刺现代官僚体系将这种反叛精神弱化为需要多层审批的像素修改
  - 提到现代瑞士制图师退休后才被"清除"的土拨鼠插图，对比中世纪的"绘制不精的海怪可能招致火刑"的冒险精神

• [实用主义赞赏视角]
  - comrade1234高度评价瑞士地形测绘局的实用价值，推荐其详细显示喷泉位置、徒步路线等地形信息的移动应用
  - sschueller补充数字地图包含噪音污染等实用数据层，强调各州免费开放地理数据的进步

• [文化彩蛋爱好者]
  - mzajc和pugworthy将这种现象与佛蒙特囚犯在警徽藏猪图案、游戏关卡设计师埋彩蛋等"隐性表达"传统相提并论
  - jmward01推荐相关主题小说《制图师》，显示公众对此类"地图谜题"的文化兴趣

• [怀疑论者]
  - jasonjmcghee对部分"隐藏图案"的真实性表示怀疑，认为可能是类似"看云识形"的过度解读
  - 725686提出实用性质疑：这些标记是否用于防伪目的

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：现代官僚体系是否扼杀了创意表达（keepamovin的批评 vs comrade1234对政府测绘服务的肯定）
• 技术细节：fotcorn指出某个徒步者图案存在20年才被移除的历史事实
• 文化延伸：CalChris和The-Bus分别联想到美国政府关闭期间的加密气象信息、瑞士巧克力商标保护等跨界话题
• 呈现方式：TwoFerMaggie对文章图片覆盖原始图案的排版设计提出批评

46107282.article_content:
A marmot hiding in plain sight in the Swiss Alps
The first three dimensions—length, height, and depth—are included on all topographical maps. The “fourth dimension,” or time, is also available on the website of the Swiss
Federal Office of Topography
(Swisstopo). In the “
Journey Through Time
,” a timeline displays 175 years of the country’s cartographic history, advancing in increments of 5-10 years. Over the course of two minutes, Switzerland is drawn and redrawn with increasing precision: inky shapes take on hard edges, blues and browns appear after the turn of the century, and in 2016, the letters drop their serifs.
Watching a single place evolve over time reveals small histories and granular inconsistencies. Train stations and airports are built, a gunpowder factory disappears for the length of the Cold War. But on certain maps, in Switzerland’s more remote regions, there is also, curiously, a spider, a man’s face, a naked woman, a hiker, a fish, and a marmot. These barely-perceptible apparitions aren’t mistakes, but rather illustrations hidden by the official cartographers at Swisstopo in defiance of their mandate “to reconstitute reality.” Maps published by Swisstopo undergo a rigorous proofreading process, so to find an illicit drawing means that the cartographer has outsmarted his colleagues.
It also implies that the mapmaker has openly violated his commitment to accuracy, risking professional repercussions on account of an alpine rodent. No cartographer has been fired over these drawings, but then again, most were only discovered once their author had already left. (Many mapmakers timed the publication of their drawing to coincide with their retirement.) Over half of the known illustrations have been removed. The latest, the marmot drawing, was discovered by Swisstopo in 2016 and is likely to be eliminated from the next official map of Switzerland by next year. As the spokesperson for Swisstopo told me, “Creativity has no place on these maps.”
A marmot hiding in plain sight in the Swiss Alps
Errors—both accidental and deliberate—are not uncommon in maps (
17
th-
century
California as an island
, the
omission of Seattle
in a 1960s AAA map). Military censors have long transformed nuclear bunkers into nondescript warehouses and routinely pixelate satellite images of sensitive sites. Many maps also contain intentional errors to trap would-be copyright violators. The work of recording reality is particularly vulnerable to plagiarism: if a cartographer is suspected of copying another’s work, he can simply claim to be duplicating the real world— ideally, the two should be the same. Mapmakers often rely on fictitious streets, typically no longer than a block, to differentiate their accounts of the truth (Oxygen Street in Edinburgh, for example).
Their entire professional life is spent at the magnification level of a postage stamp.
But there is another, less institutional reason to hide something in a map. According to Lorenz Hurni, professor of cartography at ETH Zurich, these illustrations are part inside joke, part coping mechanism. Cartographers are “quite meticulous, really high-precision people,” he says. Their entire professional life is spent at the magnification level of a postage stamp. To sustain this kind of concentration, Hurni suspects that they eventually “look for something to break out of their daily routine.” The satisfaction of these illustrations comes from their transgressive nature— the labor and secrecy required to conceal one of these visual puns.
And some of them enjoy remarkable longevity. The naked woman drawing, for example, remained hidden for almost sixty years in the municipality of Egg, in northern Switzerland. Her relatively understated shape was composed in 1958 from a swath of green countryside and the blue line of a river, her knees bending at the curve in the stream. She remained unnoticed, reclining peacefully, until 2012.
A reclining woman, hidden for almost sixty years in the municipality of Egg
Several of the other drawings came about considerably later. In 1980, a Swisstopo cartographer traced the spider over an arachnid-shaped ice field on the Eiger mountain. It faded out over the course of the decade, retracting its spindly legs in the intermediary editions. Around the same time, another cartographer concealed a freshwater fish in a French nature preserve along the Swiss border. The fish lived in the blue circumference of a marshy lake until 1989 when, according to Swisstopo, “it disappeared from the surface of the lake, diving to the depths.”
It’s unclear how these drawings made it past the institute’s proofreaders in the first place. They may have been inserted only after the maps were approved, when cartographers are asked to apply the proofreaders’ final edits. 46107282.article_summary: 瑞士地形测绘局（Swisstopo）的地图制作师们在其官方地图中隐藏了一些趣味图案，如蜘蛛、人脸、裸女、土拨鼠等。这些并非失误，而是制图师故意违反"还原现实"准则的秘密创作。多数图案在创作者退休后才被发现，其中半数已被移除。最新发现的土拨鼠图案也将于明年被删除。这些隐藏图案既是制图师缓解精密工作压力的方式，也是对体制的温和反抗。有些图案（如1958年创作的裸女）隐藏了近60年才被发现。虽然官方认为"创意在地图上没有容身之处"，但这些秘密作品展现了制图工作中的人性化一面。

data.title: Historic Engineering Wonders: Photos That Reveal How They Pulled It Off
data.author: dxs
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了古代文明在工程领域的智慧创造，展现了人类在没有现代机械的条件下，如何运用观察力和创造力解决实际问题。重点内容包括：罗马的暖气系统、秘鲁5000年前的抗震技术、古代金属夹具固定石块的工艺、庞贝古城先进的罗马水龙头、英国独特的蛇形桥梁设计、印加帝国的石桥建造技术、庞贝古城的人行横道，以及罗马道路的分层建造方法。这些古代工程不仅构思精巧，许多至今仍在使用，展现了惊人的耐用性和前瞻性。
data.comments_summary:

46045876.article_content:
Human ingenuity has produced engineering solutions that continue to inspire long after their creators disappeared into history.
Long before modern machinery, builders and inventors relied on raw skill, observation, and clever experimentation to shape cities, move water, tame landscapes, and secure structures against time and nature.
Each innovation reveals a moment when necessity met creativity, leaving behind achievements that still hold up today.
The following photographs offer a visual journey through some of the most fascinating technologies of earlier civilizations and the methods that allowed them to build with surprising precision and durability.
Hypocaust Heating System in Ancient Rome
Heating in ancient Rome reached a similar level of innovation through the hypocaust system, an early form of centralized heating.
Hot air produced in a furnace traveled beneath raised floors and sometimes through wall flues, warming entire bath complexes and public buildings.
This approach ensured consistent indoor temperatures and became one of the earliest large-scale applications of controlled environmental engineering.
A heating system from Ancient Rome.
5,000-Year-Old Anti-Seismic Foundations of Peru
Across the world in Peru, the Caral-Supe civilization developed a seismic-resistant technique more than 5,000 years ago.
Known as shicras, these woven vegetable-fiber baskets filled with stones acted as flexible foundations capable of absorbing and dispersing earthquake energy.
This method demonstrates how ancient societies responded to geological challenges with simple yet remarkably effective solutions.
An ancient anti-seismic foundations of Peru.
Metal Clamps That Held Stone Blocks in Place
The use of metal clamps to secure giant stone blocks is one of the more striking examples of practical engineering in antiquity.
These clamps, often cast in iron or copper alloys, locked masonry pieces together so effectively that many of the structures they supported remain standing after thousands of years.
Their surviving marks offer a quiet lesson in how small components can sustain monumental architecture.
Metal clamps that held stone blocks in place.
Roman Faucets from Pompeii
Among the most advanced early urban systems was Roman plumbing, represented beautifully by faucets uncovered in Pompeii dating from the 1st century BCE to the 1st century CE.
These bronze fixtures, known as
cannulae
, were part of an extensive aqueduct network that delivered water directly into homes, public baths, and fountains.
Roman faucets.
Remarkably, some designs even incorporated single-control mixers, showing a level of sophistication far ahead of their time.
The Snake Bridge on the Macclesfield Canal
Innovation also reshaped transportation systems. Bridge 77 on the Macclesfield Canal, often referred to as the snake bridge, was designed specifically to keep horses hitched to the narrowboats they pulled.
The spiral ramps allowed animals to cross the canal without interrupting their movement, eliminating the need to detach towlines.
This concept later inspired similar split or roving bridges, some built entirely of iron, where a central slot allowed tow ropes to pass through uninterrupted.
The Snake Bridge.
Inca Stone Bridge at Huarautambo
In Peru once again, the Incas demonstrated exceptional resourcefulness with their stone bridges, including the one at the Huarautambo archaeological complex.
Constructed during the reign of Pachakutiq Inka Yupanki, the bridge exemplifies how Andean engineers combined local materials and environmental understanding to create durable infrastructure in mountainous terrain.
An Inca stone bridge.
Roman Pedestrian Crossings in Pompeii
Roman streets also reveal clever design features. Pedestrian crossings in Pompeii, formed by evenly spaced stone blocks, functioned much like modern crosswalks while allowing carts to pass through the gaps.
At night, the so-called “Tiger Eyes”—small white stones placed among paving slabs—reflected any available light to help travelers navigate the roads more safely.
Construction Layers of a Roman Road
These roads were masterpieces in their own right. Roman engineers built nearly 29 major highways branching out from the capital and connected by countless secondary routes.
Their layered construction, with a raised center for drainage and ditches and culverts along the sides, enabled more than 250,000 miles of durable roadways by the 2nd century CE.
Many modern roads still follow these ancient paths, and in some places, the original Roman pavement remains in use.
An illustration of a typical Roman road.
The Sweet Track in Somerset, England
Evidence of early engineering mastery also appears in prehistoric Europe. The Sweet Track, a Neolithic timber walkway built around 3800 BCE in the Somerset Levels of England, provided a stable route across marshlands.
As one of the oldest engineered pathways in the world, it illustrates how early communities adapted their environment long before stone

data.title: A vector graphics workstation from the 70s
data.author: ibobev
data.article_summary: 这篇文章主要讲述了作者修复一台20世纪70年代的Tektronix 4051图形工作站的经历。这台机器重达35公斤，结合了Motorola 6800计算机和存储CRT技术，在1975年售价约6000美元（相当于2025年的36000美元）。作者描述了该设备的历史背景，包括Tektronix公司从示波器到图形终端的发展历程。在修复过程中，作者发现了电源开关损坏和变压器线路断裂的问题，通过焊接修复后成功通电，但在后续测试中仍有电阻烧毁的情况。文章展现了这款早期图形工作站的技术特点和作者的修复历程。

46107177.article_content:
Nov 30, 2025								   |
0 comments
A vector graphics workstation from the 70s
This repair has been on the to do list for ages, so let’s finally get to it!
In my mind, Tektronix is a brand that makes electronics lab equipment like oscilloscopes and l
ogic analyzers
. Turns out, they made quite a few terminals and a couple of computers! A good friend saw this one for sale local to him, and I poked him till he agreed on picking it up for me.
Picking it up may be the wrong wording, this thing is big and heavy! It weights about 35kg and it’s nearly a meter long!
So let’s have a look at what this is, what I needed to do to repair it and what it can do!
Some history
The machine I got is a Tektronix 4051 graphics workstation, released in 1975, but let’s look a bit at the history from Tektronix before this was released. Tektronix started in late 1945 as Tekrad, but quickly got renamed to Tektronix. One of their first products was the
511 oscilloscope
, the first oscilloscope with a trigger!
This turned out to be a good thing, and soon enough, Tektronix was synonymous with oscilloscopes and known as a company that made some of the best test and measurement equipment. In the 60s, mainframe and then minicomputers became more popular, which often needed a terminal. Tektronix at this point was making storage oscilloscopes, which use a storage CRT tube that can “remember” drawn signals. Using this technology, Tektronix released their first terminal in 1969, the
4002
. A 11″ terminal that was capable of displaying graphics with a 400×300 pixel resolution. As the CRT rememebers the drawn data, there was no need for a RAM framebuffer!
A few years later in 1971 they released the 4010, again 11″ but now with 1024*780 pixel resolution. As they used Storage CRTs, these terminals where a lot cheaper then the competitors. Mind you, cheap still means around $4000, or around $30.000 in 2025 money. But the
IBM 2250
was priced at around $280.000 That’s 1970s dollars, so well over 2 million USD today!
Before we move away from these terminals, one last cool tidbit. Tektronix made the 4010 in several sizes, the biggest being the 25″ 4016 with a 4096*3120 pixel resolution. 4K in 1974, sign me up!
The 405x computers
OK I promised computers, so let’s move to the Tek 4051 I got! Released in 1975, this was based on the 4010 series of terminals, but with a Motorola 6800 computer inside. This machine ran, like so many at the time, BASIC, but with extra subroutines for drawing and manipulating vector graphics. 8KB RAM was standard, but up to 32KB RAM could be installed. Extra software was installed via ROM modules in the back, for example to add DSP routines. Data could be saved on tape, and via RS232 and GBIP external devices could be attached!
All in all, a pretty capable machine, especially in 1975. BASIC computers where getting common, but graphics was pretty new. According to Tektronix the 4051 was ideal for researches, analysts and physicians, and this could be yours for the low low price of 6 grand, or around $36.000 in 2025. I could not find sales figures, but it seems that this was a decently successful machine. Tektronix also made the 4052, with a faster CPU, and the 4054, a 19″ 4K resolution behemoth! Tektronix continued making workstations until the 90s but like almost all workstations of the era, x86/Linux eventually took over the entire workstation market.
The 4051 was also used in a few
series/movies
, the storage CRTs do not flicker when recorded like a normal CRT and as they run basic, getting something cool on screen was fairly easy to do! The best known example was Battlestar Galactica:
Fixing a Tektronix computer
With the history out of the way, what’s the shape of the one I got?
It was stored in a shed for a long while, state unknown, but it looked like it’s in OK shape. A bit dirty but who isn’t at times. Fuse is intact, and when opening it up, nothing looked “off” no bulging caps or such. But turning it on and nothing happens. Anticlimactic…
A good bit of tracing wires later, it turned out the ON/OFF switch is broken. So to quicly remedy this, some wires can be used.
I do NOT recommend this. 230V via cheap breadboard wires is not smart. But with this, still nothing. Argh. So another bit of debugging later it turned out a wire of the mains transformer was not connected to the terminal.
It’s kind of visible in this photo, there are wires going from the transformer to the tabs to select voltages and one was broken. Luckily there was enough wire left to solder on and fix it, getting a replacement would have been impossible! After this fix, I got power! I disconnected as much as I could in order to check all the voltages I could check. We need 15V, 12V, 5V, -12, +20, -20 +185 and +365 and they turned out to all be in spec. Tektronix :)
So, time to slowly connect boards back in and see if something explodes!

data.author: surprisetalk

这篇文章介绍了如何将19世纪维多利亚风格的装饰边框转化为可重复使用的CSS边框，用于网页设计。主要步骤包括：

1. 使用Inkscape软件将扫描的边框图像矢量化
2. 分离每个重复元素并确保它们宽度相同（如22px）
3. 调整元素排列，使其能够无缝重复
4. 使用CSS的round()函数确保边框宽度始终是元素宽度的整数倍，避免截断

这种方法能创造出自然、有机的边框效果，模仿传统印刷中的不完美质感，同时确保在任何屏幕宽度下都能完美显示。

主要讨论点：[如何处理图像（特别是藤蔓图案）以优化视觉效果和实现更优雅的形状]

不同观点：
• **MarkusQ的观点**：认为选择的图像（藤蔓缠绕）本身具有连贯性，忽视这一点会导致形状不优雅。强调图像本身的连贯性对最终效果的重要性。
• **pirates的观点**：主张手动使用钢笔工具重新描绘图像，认为这样比使用自动图像追踪功能更能精确控制曲线和线条。建议通过制作形状笔刷或使用混合/步骤工具来提高效率和效果。
• **chrismorgan的观点**：提出另一种解决方案，即使用CSS的`border-image-repeat: round;`属性，尤其适用于矢量图像且允许轻微拉伸的情况。这种方法可以更灵活地处理不同的边缘图像。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于如何处理图像以达到最佳效果：是依赖图像本身的特性（MarkusQ），手动优化（pirates），还是通过CSS技术实现（chrismorgan）。
- pirates和chrismorgan的方法都提出了技术性的解决方案，但前者更侧重于设计工具的使用，后者则侧重于前端开发技术。

46035507.article_content:
Victorian-Style Lines for the Web: Elements of Identical Width
Written on
November 22, 2025
in
how to
,
Writing
In this tutorial, we will take graphical borders from the 1800s and turn them into a repeating CSS border for your website. The following technique will work for border made of almost-identical repeating elements. We’ll use the free
Inkscape illustration software
.
The end result will be this kind of border that neatly fills the parent element, no matter what the parent’s width is. Go ahead and pull at the “resize” tab to make it wider or narrower:
We will follow these steps:
Vectorizing the image of a border
Separating each repeating element from its neighbours
Rearranging the elements so they can repeat easily using CSS
Creating CSS code to ensure we’ll never cut off our border mid-element
Getting the image
We’re going to work with the borders at
Recueil des divers caractères, vignettes et ornements de la fonderie et imprimerie de J. G. Gillé
from 1808 – organically grown and Copyright Free!
In the above screenshot, the borders that work for our needs are 79, 81, 84, 85, 86 and 88. The others would work if you crop them to drop their central/edge elements which have different widths from the repeating portion.
Choose a border that is made up of the
same width
characters repeating.
I’ve chosen this one for our exercise:
We zoom in on it and take a screenshot.
Vectorizing
We will turn this flat image into a vector (SVG) so that we can easily separate the wreaths and space them out for even repetition.
Import the image into the Inkscape program (although Adobe Illustrator will also work)
Go to Path->Trace To Bitmap
You will end up with a black and white vector like this:
Separating the elements
Now, we split this one big path into parts. Go to Path->Split Path and you’ll end up with a bunch of non-overlapping little portions.
You can see the blue outlines showing distinct paths now:
But look at the red arrows where some of the wreaths have merged together. This is due to the way the original print was done – where the ink overlapped between separate elements.
We can split up that merged path by creating a rectangle on top (shown in red), selecting both the rectangle and the path, and then going to Path->Difference to cut the underlying path, then go to Path->Split Path to divide them into 2 separate paths.
You can also split the shape along thin curve by drawing with the Pen tool (don’t close the curve – just press ENTER to leave a line segment). Then, select the curve and the underlying path and go to Path->Fracture.
Go on and cut all the shapes away from each other
Then, go on and select the paths that make up each pattern element (select them, then group them with CTRL+G). When you’re done grouping, you’ll get paths that roughly correspond to individual pattern elements:
Making each wreath the same width
Next, we want each element to be the
same width
so we can predictably repeat the pattern every X pixels.
Figure out a good average width & height for one of these elements. I do it by selecting one and looking at the Width and Height in
px
at the top bar. In the example, the repeating element is 22.924px wide by 21.815px high.
Let’s go ahead and make each element
22px
wide. Select one object and change its width manually to 22px while keeping the height “locked” to the same aspect ratio with the lock icon.
Select your one object and copy it. Then, select all the other objects:
Go to Edit->Paste->Size Separately. This will give all of them the same height & width as the “reference object” you just copied. This is just a fast way to force all of them to have the same width – there are probably other ways to do the same thing.
Then we go to Object->Align and Distribute->Grid
The settings in the screenshot will distribute them horizontally with no spaces in between. If your pattern is the kind that looks good with spaces between the elements, then you can enter 1 or 2 px in that “X:” field.
We apply the grid and get elements of the same width and height, touching:
You can adjust height, and vertical offset to break up the pattern a little if you want:
I realize this is way more effort than using 1 wreath and repeating the same image as many times as we need. The goal of using the scanned wreaths and adjusting them is to create an “organic” look that imitates imperfect printing.
Give them whatever fill-colour you want and export as “Plain SVG”
Creating CSS that never cuts off mid-element
Next, we are going to set up the SVG pattern as a repeating background on an <hr> element. If we simply let the pattern repeat across 100% of the element’s width it’ll often cut off mid-element:
The key part of our CSS: only letting <hr> have a width value that’s a multiple of 22px (the width of each repeating element). The width will never be set to a value that cuts off an element.
We can do this with the CSS
round()
function:
width: round(down,100%,22px);

data.author: ferguess_k

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[笔记本电脑品牌的质量、设计、性能和用户体验比较]

不同观点：
• **支持联想ThinkPad的观点**  
  - 优点：出色的构建质量、易维护性（如底部盖设计）、良好的散热设计  
  - 例子：T14s和Legion 7i的正面体验，以及X270的耐用性  
  - 争议：AMD CPU的支持不足  

• **批评戴尔XPS的观点**  
  - 缺点：散热问题（如XPS 2020款待机温度过高）、主板故障率高、售后服务质量差  
  - 例子：XPS 13 2023款的普遍主板问题  
  - 争议：部分用户（如elseleigh）认为2017款XPS13表现优异  

• **对其他品牌的评价**  
  - 华硕S16：性能强劲但存在WiFi和睡眠问题  
  - Acer：性价比高，用户体验好于戴尔  
  - 戴尔Precision系列：部分用户（如jwagenet）认为其质量可靠  

• **市场趋势和替代方案**  
  - 批评：多数品牌走向低成本化（塑料材质、不可升级组件）  
  - 建议：购买高端产品（如MacBook）或模块化设计（如Framework）  

补充讨论：  
- **USB-C的争议**：hatmatrix认为其标准化有助于减少电子垃圾，但未直接回应批评。  
- **二手市场**：AnnaPali指出旧款高端笔记本仍具性价比，但电池寿命可能不足。  
- **品牌忠诚度**：如Zaskoda因售后问题彻底拒绝戴尔，而deepakarora3从戴尔转向Acer。

data.title: Netflix kills casting from its mobile app to most modern TVs
data.author: Brajeshwar
data.article_summary: Netflix已悄悄移除从移动应用投屏到大多数现代电视和流媒体设备的功能，包括新款Chromecast和Google TV Streamer。这一变动首先被Reddit用户发现，并在Netflix的支持页面更新中确认。现在用户只能通过电视自带的遥控器和原生Netflix应用观看内容。仅部分老旧Chromecast和内置Google Cast的电视仍支持投屏，且仅限于无广告订阅用户。Netflix未提前通知用户，称此举是为提升用户体验。类似2019年取消iOS应用AirPlay支持的做法。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Netflix取消投屏功能及其对用户体验的影响，以及流媒体服务的整体趋势。

不同观点：
• **支持取消投屏功能的观点**  
  - Netflix可能出于商业策略（如推动用户升级到更高价位的无广告套餐）或保护用户体验（如避免账户被滥用）而做出此决定。  
  - 部分用户提到投屏功能可能导致账户安全问题（如[nmcfarl]的经历）。  

• **反对取消投屏功能的观点**  
  - 用户认为这一决定增加了使用门槛，甚至比盗版更不便（如[Rebelgecko][quxbar]）。  
  - 批评Netflix的垄断行为（如[paxys][nerdjon]）和短视的盈利策略（如[bryanlarsen][wrxd]）。  
  - 实际使用场景受限（如酒店、家庭共享等，见[koinedad][stuaxo]）。  

• **其他相关讨论**  
  - 区域锁定问题（如[cultofmetatron]被迫转向盗版）。  
  - 流媒体服务的碎片化导致用户回归盗版（如[quxbar][jerlam]）。  

争议焦点：  
- **商业利益 vs 用户体验**：Netflix是否通过限制功能过度追求利润，牺牲了用户便利性？  
- **技术倒退**：为何智能家居和流媒体技术反而变得更封闭（如[paxys]提到的“围墙花园”问题）？  

补充讨论：  
- 部分用户提出替代方案（如直接连接PC到电视[lunias]，或依赖其他免费平台[jerlam]）。  
- 对Netflix长期策略的质疑（如[nerdjon]认为其试图完全控制用户体验）。

46108106.article_content:
Netflix Kills Casting From Its Mobile App to Most Modern TVs
Monday December 1, 2025 4:36 am PST
by
Tim Hardwick
Netflix has quietly removed the ability to cast content from its mobile apps to most modern TVs and streaming devices, including newer Chromecast models and the Google TV Streamer.
The change was first spotted by users on
Reddit
and confirmed in an updated
Netflix support page
(via
Android Authority
), which now states that the streaming service no longer supports casting from mobile devices to most TVs and TV-streaming devices. Users are instead directed to use the remote that came with their TV hardware and use its native Netflix app.
The only exception appears to apply to older Chromecast models without remotes, as well as TVs with built-in Google Cast support. However, even on these legacy devices, casting only remains for those on costlier ad-free plans, but it is unavailable for subscribers on Netflix's ad-supported plan.
User reports appear to suggest Netflix began removing the Cast button from its mobile apps in mid-November, but the company provided no advance warning to users.
One Reddit user
said customer service explained that devices with remotes can no longer cast, claiming the decision was made to improve the customer experience.
The move bears similarities to Netflix's
2019 decision
to remove AirPlay support from its iOS app, citing an inability to distinguish between different AirPlay-enabled devices (i.e., what is an ‌Apple TV‌ vs. what isn't) as Apple expanded the technology to third-party TVs.

data.title: 14yo won $25k for origami, discovered pattern that holds 10k times its weight
data.author: Bootvis
data.article_summary: 《商业内幕》专注于报道创新商业故事，提供读者想了解的行业前沿动态。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[14岁少年发现折纸结构在救灾中的应用是否被夸大]

不同观点：
• [质疑观点]
  - 标题误导：该少年并未"发现"Miura-ori折纸模式（这种模式早已存在），只是测量了其承重能力

data.title: WhatsApp will become interoperable with other messaging apps in Europe
data.author: marvinborner
data.article_summary: Meta宣布，由于欧盟《数字市场法案》的要求，WhatsApp欧洲用户未来可通过第三方聊天功能与其他互通应用的用户直接通信，首批接入的是BirdyChat和Haiket。该功能支持文字、图片、视频等传输，初期暂不支持跨平台群聊。Meta强调这一开发耗时三年，在满足法规的同时确保用户隐私安全。此举打破了WhatsApp的市场垄断，为小型通讯应用提供竞争机会，也赋予欧洲用户更多选择权。不过Signal和Threema等注重隐私的应用已明确表示不会与WhatsApp互通。该变化被视为Meta顺应欧盟监管的积极举措。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[WhatsApp的互操作性、开放协议的必要性、多消息应用冗余问题、隐私与数据管理]

不同观点：
• **WhatsApp的限制与隐私问题**  
  - anonymars批评WhatsApp强制要求访问联系人权限，并对Meta（Facebook）表示强烈不满，认为其行为具有侵入性。  
  - daft_pink提到不希望自己的消息通过WhatsApp/Meta传输，尤其是在其国家使用率不高的情况下。

• **对多消息应用冗余的抱怨**  
  - hmokiguess和pogue表达了对当前需要安装多个消息应用的烦恼，怀念过去单一客户端（如IRC或Pidgin）的简洁性。  
  - pogue呼吁开发一个现代的多协议客户端（类似Trillian或Pidgin）以统一管理所有聊天服务。

• **开放协议与互操作性的需求**  
  - zenoprax强调需要回归开放标准（如Matrix、XMPP），但指出当前解决方案（如Matrix的密钥管理）对普通用户过于复杂。  
  - benoau和qubex提出希望消息应用（如iOS的Messages）能通过插件支持多协议互操作，减少平台依赖性。  
  - lupire回顾了Facebook和Google Talk（gTalk）因放弃XMPP而导致的“聊天孤岛战争”。

• **技术实现的担忧与可能性**  
  - timpera对互操作性可能带来的垃圾邮件问题表示担忧。  
  - sva_和alex_duf探讨了端到端加密（e2e）在互操作性中的技术可行性，尤其是Signal与WhatsApp的潜在互通。  

补充讨论：

  - prmph呼吁改进消息导出/导入功能，避免因切换设备丢失数据。

46107109.article_content:
Meta has announced that WhatsApp users in Europe will soon be able to message people using other messaging services that are interoperable with WhatsApp, due to the interoperability requirements under the Digital Market Acts. This marks a big win as it creates a more equal playing field for smaller messaging services, which will soon have a greater chance of being used. It also signifies a positive change for people in Europe who will have more choice when it comes to how and over which platform they choose to message people.
Say hello to chat interoperability!
Meta has announced
it’s preparing to launch WhatsApp third-party chat interoperability for its users in Europe, which will be rolled out over the coming months. This means that WhatsApp users will have an option to chat with users on alternative messaging apps such as BirdyChat and Haiket directly, using a feature called
third-party chats.
This feature is available as an opt-in for users on iOS and Android. With third-party chats, you will be able to message, send images, videos, voice messages, and files to users on messaging apps that have enabled interoperability with WhatsApp. Creating groups with third-party users on other platforms will not be possible initially, but it will become available in the future.
With the announcement of third-party chat integration, Meta also emphasized that the development had taken more than three years of work with European messaging services and the European Commission to ensure the solution met the
requirements of the DMA
while also preserving its users’ privacy and security.
We have built third-party interoperability, maintaining E2EE and other privacy guarantees in our services as far as possible”, Meta said.

Positive changes ahead
BirdyChat and Haiket are the first two messaging apps that will initially be interoperable with WhatsApp. While these apps may not be popular or well known, the development of third-party messaging integration into Meta’s WhatsApp is still a great achievement because:
1. Meta is complying with the EU’s DMA
Meta is an American-owned Tech Giant that profits from the ad-based business model. It’s known for it’s rampant and invasive data collection practices and processing – which it often gets criticized and sometimes punished for in the European Union.
For example, in
2023, the EU banned personalized ads on FaceBook and Instagram
, and earlier this year it came under fire for
using the public data of EU citizens despite GDPR data protection to train  AI models
– on which the tech giant argues it needed the data out of “Legitimate interest.”
But now, Meta sees itself pressured into adhering to the DMA regulation, which is a positive step in the right direction and might break the messaging monopoly that WhatsApp currently holds over in the EU and beyond. With becoming interoperable, smaller messaging apps finally get the chance to compete in the market and gain market share, which might lead to better services, more privacy, and a fairer treatment of users.
Implementing changes due to requirements of the EU’s DMA is not exclusive to Meta. Other tech giants like Apple, Google, and Microsoft are also required to make changes due to the DMA, but often find sneaky loopholes in the system. A perfect example is how the
DMA required Apple to allow for app sideloading on iOS devices
: Apple made this possible
BUT
with a catch, it would charge any developers who take this route absurd commission fees – a perfect example of malicious compliance.
So, considering how other tech giants have maliciously complied, Meta making WhatsApp Messenger interoperable is a step in the right direction.
2. Greater freedom of choice for Europeans
Like choosing an email provider and being able to send emails to anyone, the same will be possible in the future for WhatsApp users in Europe. The more messengers that become interoperable with WhatsApp – the more freedom of choice people have to choose different messenger platforms. This is also important because it gives small players a chance to gain customers and enter the market.
Speaking from personal experience, the introduction of
Meta AI in my WhatsApp
and other unwanted features like
ads in WhatsApp stories
this year has given me more than enough reason to switch to a
WhatsApp alternative
. Now, what is even better is that if I do decide to ditch WhatsApp entirely, I’ll soon be able to message my friends and family who aren’t ready to switch from WhatsApp. And all thanks to the DMA!

What’s next
As reported by
Heise Online, Signal and Threema will not establish connections allowing for interoperability with WhatsApp
. Both of these end-to-end encrypted messengers are known for their strong stance on privacy and security, and neither of them plans to change their security standards to become compatible with the Meta-owned instant messenger.

data.title: ImAnim: Modern animation capabilities to ImGui applications
data.author: klaussilveira
data.article_summary: ImAnim是一个专为Dear ImGui设计的动画引擎，提供30多种缓动函数、色彩混合和路径动画等功能。主要特点包括即时模式友好、无额外依赖、支持多种动画类型（如浮点、向量、颜色）和策略（交叉渐变、队列等）。它易于集成，仅需添加两个文件，并附有详细文档和演示程序展示所有特性。项目采用MIT许可证，适合Dear ImGui社区使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[ImGui动画库的构建问题、适用性及实现方式]

不同观点：
• [构建问题与挫折]
  - jandrese详细描述了尝试构建动画库时的困难，包括环境配置错误、脚本问题以及C#和C++的兼容性问题，最终未能成功构建。
  - 指出脚本的不足和文档的误导性，期望其他人能解决这些问题。

• [简易安装与使用]

  - elpocko认为ImGui适合开发工具但不适合终端用户应用，批评其非标准用户体验和可能的可访问性问题，担心动画会进一步恶化这种情况。
  - ryanmcbride则对动画效果表示赞赏，认为它符合自己的审美需求。

data.title: Isn't WSL2 just a VM?
data.author: sedatk
data.article_summary: 本文主要介绍了Windows NT中的子系统概念及其演变。最初，NT通过轻量级API转换支持其他操作系统程序（如OS/2、POSIX）。Windows自身也是NT架构下的一个子系统（CSRSS.EXE）。后来微软推出了WSL1，作为Linux的轻量级转换层，占用资源少但存在性能问题。为改进性能，微软开发了WSL2，采用完整的Hyper-V虚拟机方案，运行真实Linux内核，解决了I/O性能问题但启动较慢。两者可互相转换，各有利弊。WSL2支持自定义内核，提供了更完整的Linux体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[WSL 2 的技术实现、优缺点及其与 WSL 1 的对比]

不同观点：
• **WSL 2 是一种优化的轻量级虚拟机**  
  - 基于 Hyper-V，但进行了特殊优化（如 GPU 分区和 DirectX 支持）  
  - 类似 Firecracker，启动快、内存占用低，但需要较多内存（推荐 8-16GB 以上）  
  - 示例：用户 [andix] 和 [pjmlp] 提到其技术背景（如 Drawbridge 技术）  

• **WSL 1 的独特价值被忽视**  
  - WSL 1 是 Pico 进程而非虚拟机，支持与 Windows 的无缝交互（如共享文件描述符）  
  - 用户 [finaard] 指出其在 CI 环境中的优势，而 WSL 2 需要复杂变通  
  - 争议点：微软放弃 WSL 1 开发是否合理
